verdict.rationale: The documented paths are remote: filings are fully dematerialized with no need to travel (docs-2). Signing in via FranceConnect+ replaces the advanced-signature requirement (docs-15). Otherwise, filers sign with an advanced e-signature based on a qualified certificate from a certification body, and EU certificates are accepted (supp-1, docs-14). The evidence never describes what FranceConnect+ or certificate issuance actually requires of the human, so it cannot confirm the path avoids biometric liveness, in-person identity proofing or a PIN sent by post. Missing for 10: documentation that the FranceConnect+ or qualified-certificate enrollment is plain credential MFA completable remotely, explicit exclusion of liveness, in-person or postal-PIN steps, and hands-on corroboration of the sign-in flow.
